name: com.swirepay.android_sdk.ui.base.BaseActivity
description: The Swirepay Android SDK's abstract base Activity supplies the shared in-app browser and file-selection behavior used by several specific payment and account screens. The SDK opens those specific screens; this base has no separate user-facing page.
disableEffect: This abstract base Activity has no separate screen or task, so blocking its entry has no independent user-visible effect.
